About AnantLink

Software shaped around the way hospitals work.

AnantLink is an early-stage team building connected-care tools for hospitals. We bring patient signals, devices, and operational workflows into one view.

Our Mission

Give every hospital
the data it needs.

Our goal is to make relevant information easier to reach—whether it comes from a bedside monitor, a room sensor, or an existing hospital system. The platform is modular, so teams can begin with a focused workflow.

How We Work

Principles we don't compromise on.

Clinical first

We start with the workflow: what a clinician needs to see, when they need it, and what should happen next.

Built for hospital conditions

Connectivity, existing devices, and local operating requirements shape how we design the platform.

Security by design

Access controls and deployment choices are part of the system design from the start.

Designed to connect

The platform is being built to work with existing hospital systems and equipment.
